title: AREX-2: Advancing Self-Improving Agents through Long-Horizon Reflective Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2609.38288v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present AREX-2, an effort to advance the self-improving capability of LLM agents, which we define as the ability to iteratively refine a solution at test time. This ability rests on two complementary capabilities: reflection, which produces a solution better than the current one, and long-horizon execution, which keeps the iteration effective over many rounds. We hypothesize that both capabilities are domain-agnostic, and can therefore be learned in scenarios that are well suited for supervision. Accordingly, we synthesize long-horizon improvement trajectories from machine learning and algorithmic programming tasks, two domains that offer verifiable feedback and reward sustained iteration. translated_title: AREX-2：通过长程反思任务推进自我改进智能体
translated_abstract: 我们提出AREX-2，旨在提升LLM智能体的自我改进能力，我们将其定义为在测试时迭代改进解决方案的能力。这一能力依赖于两种互补的能力：反思，即产出比当前方案更好的解决方案；以及长程执行，即在多轮迭代中保持改进的有效性。我们假设这两种能力都是领域无关的，因此可以在非常适合监督学习的场景中习得。为此，我们从机器学习和算法编程任务中合成了长程改进轨迹，这两个领域能提供可验证的反馈并奖励持续迭代。基于这些数据训练后，我们构建于Qwen3.8-27B之上的智能体在MLE-bench Lite（81.8分）和Frontier-CS（70.7分）上取得了强劲结果，并能迁移至深度研究任务，在BrowseComp上达到84.0分、在HLE上达到52.6分、在GAIA上达到92.2分、在DeepSearchQA上达到93.8分，且保持持续改进。
tldr: AREX-2利用机器学习和算法编程这两个具有可验证反馈的领域合成长程改进轨迹，训练LLM智能体的反思与长程执行能力，使基于Qwen3.8-27B的智能体在MLE-bench Lite和Frontier-CS等基准上表现强劲，并能迁移到深度研究等新任务。
en_tdlr: AREX-2 synthesizes long-horizon improvement trajectories from verifiable-feedback domains like machine learning and algorithmic programming to train LLM agents' reflection and long-horizon execution capabilities, enabling a Qwen3.8-27B-based agent to achieve strong results on MLE-bench Lite and Frontier-CS while transferring to deep research tasks.
